The dish looks like a paper plate about 20 cm across, and it holds roughly 17 almonds.

A single almond weighs about 1.2 g, and the ones here look fairly large, so I'll use about 1.3 g each. That gives about 22 g in total.

Almonds run about 5.8 kcal per gram, so 22 g comes to roughly 128 kcal.
